compatibilityWarnings.name: stale Asgard release baseline
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: asgard-framework-overview 仍把 5.0.1 写成最新基线，而当前 Asgard 审核基线是 5.1.3。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: asgard-framework-overview still calls 5.0.1 the latest baseline while the reviewed Asgard baseline is 5.1.3.

compatibilityWarnings.name: fixed mini issuer template
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: asgard-mini-jwt-issuer 仍给出 fixed issuerTemplate；它与 5.1.3 要求恰好一个 {tenant} 的 host.auth 合同冲突。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: asgard-mini-jwt-issuer still shows a fixed issuerTemplate that conflicts with the 5.1.3 host.auth contract requiring exactly one {tenant}.

compatibilityWarnings.name: stale host auth tenant placeholder
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: asgard-host-features 仍使用 {tenantId}；5.1.3 只接受 {tenant}，照抄会在配置校验阶段失败。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: asgard-host-features still uses {tenantId}; 5.1.3 accepts only {tenant}, so copying it fails configuration validation.

compatibilityWarnings.name: stale database routing template
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: question-routing 模板仍把数据库路由写成 EF Core，并遗漏当前部分身份、追踪、测试与复查入口。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: The question-routing template still routes database work as EF Core and omits some current identity, tracing, testing, and review entries.

compatibilityWarnings.name: stale static default-file default
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: asgard-host-features 仍把 host.staticFiles.enableDefaultFiles 描述为默认开启；5.1.3 实际默认 false。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: asgard-host-features still describes host.staticFiles.enableDefaultFiles as enabled by default; 5.1.3 actually defaults it to false.

compatibilityWarnings.name: stale health-check endpoint key
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: asgard-host-features 仍使用旧 healthCheck endpoint；5.1.3 的有效键是 host.healthCheck.path。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: asgard-host-features still uses the obsolete health-check endpoint key; 5.1.3 reads host.healthCheck.path.

compatibilityWarnings.name: overstated middleware placement control
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: asgard-host-project 把 ConfigureMiddleware 描述为 arbitrary placement；当前主路径不保证任意位置控制。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: asgard-host-project describes ConfigureMiddleware as arbitrary placement, which the current primary path does not guarantee.

compatibilityWarnings.name: unreliable pre-framework override claim
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: host-project 与 plugin-lifecycle 暗示钩子可 override later framework registrations；当前注册顺序不保证该语义。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: host-project and plugin-lifecycle imply hooks can override later framework registrations; current registration order does not guarantee that behavior.

compatibilityWarnings.name: overstated plugin state transition graph
compatibilityWarnings.source: Unloaded → Loading → Loaded → Initializing → Initialized → Starting → Running
compatibilityWarnings.content: does not write most transient states
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: plugin-lifecycle 展示完整状态图，但当前主路径 does not write most transient states，不能把它当作可观测事实。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: plugin-lifecycle shows a complete graph, but the primary path does not write most transient states, so it is not an observable runtime contract.

compatibilityWarnings.name: automatic discovery assumption
compatibilityWarnings.source: 由 AI 助手自动加载使用
compatibilityWarnings.content: Do not assume that placing the repository under a project makes every agent load it
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceZh: Do not assume that placing the repository under a project makes every agent load it；必须验证实际发现根与下一轮加载结果。
compatibilityWarnings.guidanceEn: Do not assume that placing the repository under a project makes every agent load it; verify the discovery root and the next-turn load result.
